import Wrapped4.NearBinary
open Wrapped4
def Research201 : Prop := ∀ (a b c d e f x : Nat),
  applyWrappedOps (sixUniqueFarOps 10) ([a, b, c, d, e, f] ++ List.replicate 4 x) =
    List.replicate 3 x ++ [f, e, d, c, b, a] ++ [x]

import Wrapped4.NearBinary
open Wrapped4
def Research202 : Prop := ∀ (n : Nat), 10 ≤ n → ∀ (a b c d e f x : Nat),
  applyWrappedOps (sixUniqueFarOps n) ([a, b, c, d, e, f] ++ List.replicate (n - 6) x) =
    List.replicate (n - 7) x ++ [f, e, d, c, b, a] ++ [x]

import Wrapped4.NearBinary
open Wrapped4
def Research203 : Prop := ∀ (n : Nat), 10 ≤ n → (sixUniqueFarOps n).length = n - 2

import Wrapped4.NearBinary
open Wrapped4
def Research204 : Prop := (sixUniqueFarOps 14).length = 12

import Wrapped4.NearBinary
open Wrapped4
def Research205 : Prop := ∀ (C : List Nat) (a b c d e f x : Nat),
  applyWrappedOps (sixUniqueFarOps (C.length + 10)) ([a, b, c, d, e, f] ++ C ++ List.replicate 4 x) =
    [x, x, x] ++ C ++ [f, e, d, c, b, a] ++ [x]

import Wrapped4.NearBinary
open Wrapped4
def Research206 : Prop := ∀ (G : List Nat) (m : Nat) (a b c d e f x : Nat),
  applyWrappedOps (sixUniqueFarOps (G.length + m + 10)) ([a, b, c, d, e, f] ++ G ++ List.replicate (m + 4) x) =
    [x, x, x] ++ G ++ List.replicate m x ++ [f, e, d, c, b, a] ++ [x]

import Wrapped4.NearBinary
open Wrapped4
def Research207 : Prop := ∀ (C D : List Nat) (k : Nat),
  List.take (C.length + k) (C ++ D) = C ++ List.take k D

import Wrapped4.NearBinary
open Wrapped4
def Research208 : Prop := ∀ (P B : List Nat) (a b c d : Nat),
  rightWrapped4 P.length (P ++ [a, b, c, d] ++ B) = P ++ [d, a, b, c] ++ B

import Wrapped4.NearBinary
open Wrapped4
def Research209 : Prop := (sixUniqueFarOps 9).length = 7

import Wrapped4.NearBinary
open Wrapped4
def Research210 : Prop :=
  applyWrappedOps (sixUniqueFarOps 10) ([0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5] ++ List.replicate 4 6) =
    [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5] ++ List.replicate 4 6

import Wrapped4.NearBinary
open Wrapped4
def Research211 : Prop := ∀ (n : Nat), (sixUniqueFarOps n).length = n - 2

import Wrapped4.NearBinary
open Wrapped4
def Research212 : Prop := ∀ (n : Nat) (a b c d e f x : Nat),
  applyWrappedOps (sixUniqueFarOps n) ([a, b, c, d, e, f] ++ List.replicate (n - 6) x) =
    List.replicate (n - 7) x ++ [f, e, d, c, b, a] ++ [x]
